citations.claim: cart starts offset left and moving left
cart drifts steadily left while pole stays balanced, nearly at track end
first cart_in_track violation, cart past -2.4 end

counterfactual.change: set initial cart velocity v from -0.48 to 0.0, keeping everything else identical; cart then only reaches x=-1.51 at step 264 and no rule is violated, showing the initial leftward velocity plus uncorrected drift caused the track exit

explanation: The state-feedback controller prioritizes pole balance over cart centering: pole angle stays near -0.05 to -0.08 rad (margin ~0.72) with small corrective force (~0.3-0.9 N, far below the 41.4 N limit), while the cart drifts monotonically left from x=-0.31 (v=-0.48) through x=-1.62 at step 200 to x=-2.35 at step 260 and off the track at step 264. With no pushes or noise, the unchecked positional drift accumulates until cart_in_track is violated.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.409 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart sits at the far left edge in all four tiles while the pole on top stays near upright. Across steps 261 to 264 the cart drifts further left out of frame instead of returning toward center.
